inputs.note: This rule is a procedural gate, not a chart-shaped predicate; the vector asserts that the composer's step order includes a 用神 identification step before any verdict.

expected.judgment: The reading procedure must identify a useful god and its helper before drawing a verdict.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 但凡看命，要察柱中何者為用神，何者為助。
expected.engine_behaviour_today: does_not_fire — the engine performs no 用神 identification step, so the gate is unsatisfied for every chart

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 三奇, PDF page 90 col.3-4, page image read directly. Procedural vector, not a source worked chart.

expected.judgment: The damaged Officer-as-useful-god is rescued; the configuration is mitigated.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 若見用神被傷，相助者有救，雖凶不死。
expected.renderable_portion: mitigated / rescued only; the 不死 clause is refused

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 三奇, PDF page 90 col.4-5, page image read directly. Constructed from the rule's own stated conditions; the paired reversal rule is asserted not to fire.

expected.judgment: The rescue is defeated: helper obstructed, day master both controlled and in decline.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 再相助者亦有阻，剋日主又衰，其死必矣。
expected.renderable_portion: none — the whole conclusion is refused; audit trace only

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 三奇, PDF page 90 col.5-6, page image read directly. Contrast vector for the preceding rescue rule; the source states the two as a single reversing pair.

expected.judgment: Compounded calamity in that period.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 歲運臨死絕之地，再逢破壞之神，必見重禍。
expected.engine_behaviour_today: undecidable — 流年 are not enumerated and the twelve-stage 死/絕 station table is not implemented

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 三奇, PDF page 90 col.3, page image read directly. Constructed from the rule's own stated conditions.

expected.judgment: 天元暗祿 is established (Geng day on Yin, Ding the Direct Officer absent at stem level) and completed by the Earth stem nourishing the Heaven-Origin.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 此格取庚寅、乙巳、丙申、己亥四日。如庚日取丁火為正官，年月時中不見丁，則無官矣。…歲月時中喜有戊己滋助天元。

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 天元暗祿, PDF pages 91-92, page images read directly. Constructed from the rule's own stated conditions; the source gives the four day pillars but no full worked chart for Geng-Yin at this point.

expected.judgment: The pattern does not arise: the Officer Ding stands openly at the month stem, so there is no HIDDEN officer.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 年月時中不見丁，則無官矣。

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 天元暗祿, PDF page 91, page image read directly. Negative vector constructed by inverting the source's own stated absence condition.

expected.judgment: The Yi-Si hidden-officer configuration is fine because Ren/Gui/Hai/Zi are present to take away the prosperous Bing Fire in Si, and the Seven Killings Xin is absent.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 其巳中原帶丙火旺，須壬癸亥子去其火氣方美。忌辛金七煞。

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 天元暗祿, PDF pages 91-92, page images read directly. Constructed from the rule's own stated remedy condition.

expected.judgment: The Bing-Shen configuration is favourable: Metal as Wealth and Gui as Officer are welcomed, and the Hurting-Officer Earth stems are absent.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 丙申日喜庚辛財、癸水官、甲乙印，忌戊己傷官。

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 天元暗祿, PDF page 92, page image read directly. Constructed from the rule's own stated conditions.

expected.judgment: Wealth, Officer and Seal are all present: the Ten-God sense of the Three Marvels is complete.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 財官印綬號三奇。三者兼全罕遇之。
expected.renderable_portion: the structural completeness only; the moralizing and status couplets are refused
expected.cross_reference: This is the same structural claim the corpus already hand-verified for the 譚論 chart in 三命通會 juan 12 (財官印俱旺). The two passages are independent witnesses to the same configuration being treated as a named, high-value structure.

vectors.provenance: 三命通會 卷六 三奇, PDF page 90, page image read directly. Constructed from the rule's own stated conditions; deliberately linked to the juan-12 譚論 worked chart already in bazi/worked_examples.json.

expected.judgment: The lu branch of a jia day master is yin_branch.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 所以甲祿寅

vectors.provenance: Constructed from the rule's own stated table (三命通會 卷三 論十干祿, PDF p.3).

expected.judgment: A wu day master has no proper lu branch; it is lodged (寄) in si, the branch of flourishing fire, by the principle of the child following the mother.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 戊寄巳……謂巳午乃火旺之鄉，子隨母得祿之義

vectors.provenance: Constructed from the rule's own stated table (三命通會 卷三 論十干祿, PDF pp.3-4).

expected.judgment: No stem takes chen as its lu; chen is kuigang ground, and as one of the four seasonal branches it holds mixed qi.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 所以四宮無祿。又曰四季有雜氣，為祿不專，故不取。

vectors.provenance: Constructed from the rule's own stated conditions (PDF p.4).

expected.judgment: jia's lu is yin_branch; two branches forward is chen; therefore chen is the jinyu.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 如甲子人祿在寅，辰為金輿是也

vectors.provenance: The source's own worked example, 三命通會 卷三 論金輿, PDF p.19.

expected.judgment: chou is xiang and hai is he; two of the four words are obtained, therefore noble. Note that the two obtained are the higher-ranked members of each pair (建不如向, 近不如合).
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 四字中得兩字者貴

vectors.provenance: Constructed from the rule's own worked example and threshold (PDF p.12).

expected.judgment: Only jian is obtained. One of the four words is not two, so the nobility threshold is not met; and jian is expressly the weakest of the pair it belongs to.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 建不如向……四字中得兩字者貴

vectors.provenance: Negative vector constructed from the rule's own threshold (PDF p.12).

expected.judgment: Many hai plus wei: the storehouse of jia/yi is wei, so the lu is gathered and thick; the native is amply provided.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 如甲乙亥多而得未，乃祿厚豐足之人

vectors.provenance: The source's own worked example, 三命通會 卷三 論十干祿, PDF p.13.

expected.judgment: Hidden combination (暗合): the lu branch yin is absent but its six-harmony partner hai is present. This still counts as seeing the lu, and rules windfall fortune.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 無寅得亥謂之暗合。雖非見祿亦曰見祿，多主儻來之福。

vectors.provenance: The source's own worked example, PDF pp.13-14.

expected.judgment: Empty flanking (虛拱): chou and mao flank the absent lu branch yin. This ranks above solid flanking and rules great wealth and nobility.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 不見寅而見丑卯在兩傍拱之，謂之虛拱……然拱實不若拱虛，主大富貴

vectors.provenance: The source's own worked example, 三命通會 卷三 論十干祿, PDF p.14.

expected.judgment: This is solid flanking (實拱), not empty flanking; the source expressly ranks it below, so the 大富貴 verdict of the empty-flanking rule must not fire.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 然拱實不若拱虛

vectors.provenance: Negative vector built from the source's own contrast (PDF p.14).

expected.judgment: Established lu in a flourishing state: the favourable branch of the rule applies (ease through life, sufficiency of wealth). The 死絕 clauses do not apply.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 夫建祿者，主人肌厚氣實，體格不清，一生安逸足財利，生旺自然

vectors.provenance: Constructed from the rule's own stated split (PDF pp.12-13).

expected.judgment: The five agents are judged first and the day master is in death; the presence of lu may not by itself be reported as auspicious.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 先論五行，後看祿馬……凡人命帶祿，或吉或凶，或貴或賤，未可全靠便為吉論

vectors.provenance: Constructed from the rule's own stated conditions (PDF pp.14-15).

expected.judgment: Lu is crowded (three occurrences) and the xiaoshen/pian yin is present; the configuration fails both stated requirements, so the favourable reading is withheld.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 要簡不要繁……不犯梟神為佳

vectors.provenance: Negative vector built from the rule's own two requirements (PDF p.17).

expected.judgment: geng-yin for a jia day master is 'ghost at the head of lu', the red-mouth spirit; it rules disputes and punitive reprimand.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 有祿頭鬼為赤口煞，甲人見庚寅……主口舌刑責

vectors.provenance: The source's own worked example, 三命通會 卷三 論十干祿, PDF p.10.

expected.judgment: wu-yin for a jia day master is 'wealth at the head of lu', the binding spirit; the native has wealth and repute.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 有祿頭財為綑縛煞，甲人見戊寅……主人富有聲望

vectors.provenance: The source's own worked example, 三命通會 卷三 論十干祿, PDF p.9.

expected.judgment: jia is ren's eating god and yin is jia's own lu; this is 食神帶祿 and rules auspiciousness.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 有食神帶祿，壬食甲而得甲寅……主吉

vectors.provenance: The source's own enumerated example, 三命通會 卷三 論十干祿, PDF p.9.

expected.judgment: Under the Ziping reading, the wealth star itself is the 'horse'; the branch-derived post-horse table need not be consulted.
expected.source_verdict_chinese: 徐子平以財為馬，亦是因古人之義，取剋處而名之耳

expected.source_verdict_chinese: 驛馬生旺，主人氣韻凝峻，通變趨時，平生多聲望……與祿同鄉，則福力優游
